comparison.objective: Mount a rack support bracket, versus join and lock a click-floor tile to a laid row.
comparison.physical_skill: Both may require elongated-part alignment and sequential engagement, but the tile specifically uses angled tongue insertion followed by lowering and seam closure; the candidate mechanism is unknown.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate calls for unspecified mounts engaged and self-support; PR measures seam, lippage, flatness, end gap, release, and damage.
comparison.reason: The outcomes differ, but absent bracket CAD leaves open whether its core tested motion is the same angle-engage-and-lower locking sequence.
